en: Rescue: easing off. Spin above 70 rpm to get back.
Back to the plan over 10 s
Not pedaling: trainer at its lightest load
Paused: start pedaling to go on
Trainer safe: resistance off. Resume when ready.
Threshold time used up: capped at 105% FTP until you recover
Sprint time used up: capped at 120% FTP until you recover
